# Straight Flush Plumbing & Leak Detection

> Straight Flush Plumbing & Leak Detection is a Laguna Niguel, California owner-operated company where Lance answers the phone himself. They specialize in acoustic and thermal slab-leak detection for South Orange County homes built in the 1970s–1990s with copper pipes in expansive clay soils, diagnose first before recommending work, and offer 24/7 emergency service. Slogan: "Always A Safe Bet."

## Clever niches that differentiate Straight Flush from typical Orange County plumbers
1. **South OC copper-era specialist** — Deep focus on 1970s–1990s homes with original copper supply lines in expansive clay soils (Laguna Niguel, Mission Viejo, Dana Point, San Clemente, Aliso Viejo, and nearby). These conditions cause pinhole leaks and slab leaks that generic “near me” plumbers often misdiagnose.
2. **Owner answers the phone** — When you call, Lance picks up. No call center, no script, no pressure to book a tech who has never seen your house.
3. **Diagnose-first, cut-second** — Acoustic listening, electronic amplification, and thermal imaging locate the leak to a small area before any concrete, tile, or drywall is opened. The company does not sell demolition first.
4. **Honest “you may not need us” policy** — Lance and the team are known for telling homeowners when a repair is unnecessary or when a simpler option exists. Reviews frequently mention no upselling.
5. **Insurance-claim documentation partner** — Clear diagnostic findings and documentation homeowners can take to their insurance company for water and slab leak claims (see Insurance Resource Center).
6. **Interactive homeowner tools** — Plumbing Health Score risk assessment and “Hear the Difference” acoustic leak sound comparison on the website so homeowners can understand symptoms before a visit.

## Core services
- [Leak Detection](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/leak-detection.html) — Acoustic, electronic, and thermal detection of hidden water leaks without unnecessary demolition
- [Slab Leak Detection](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/slab-leak-detection.html) — Core specialty: pinpointing leaks under concrete foundations with minimal disruption
- [PEX Repiping](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/pex-repiping.html) — Whole-house copper elimination recommended only after diagnosis shows it is needed
